description: Email sending via SendGrid or Mailgun

env_vars.name: SENDGRID_API_KEY
env_vars.description: SendGrid API key (required if provider is sendgrid)

env_vars.name: MAILGUN_API_KEY
env_vars.description: Mailgun API key (required if provider is mailgun)

env_vars.name: MAILGUN_DOMAIN
env_vars.description: Mailgun domain (required if provider is mailgun, e.g., 'mg.yourdomain.com')

env_vars.name: EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS
env_vars.description: Sender email address (must be verified with provider)
